cost_entries_shared_unattributed_check.name: cost_entries_shared_unattributed_check
cost_entries_shared_unattributed_check.value: "cost_entries"."job_id" is not null or "cost_entries"."kind" = 'llm' or ("cost_entries"."user_id" is null and "cost_entries"."team_id" is null and "cost_entries"."store_id" is null)

cost_entries_llm_check.name: cost_entries_llm_check
cost_entries_llm_check.value: "cost_entries"."kind" <> 'llm' or ("cost_entries"."user_id" is not null and "cost_entries"."team_id" is not null and "cost_entries"."day" is not null and "cost_entries"."ref" is not null and ("cost_entries"."job_id" is null) = "cost_entries"."is_final")

cost_entries_day_check.name: cost_entries_day_check
cost_entries_day_check.value: "cost_entries"."job_id" is null or "cost_entries"."day" is not null

model_configs_enabled_complete_check.name: model_configs_enabled_complete_check
model_configs_enabled_complete_check.value: not "model_configs"."enabled" or ("model_configs"."kind" = 'video' and "model_configs"."usd_per_second" is not null and "model_configs"."max_images" is not null and "model_configs"."output_resolution" is not null and cardinality("model_configs"."ratios") > 0 and cardinality("model_configs"."durations_sec") > 0) or ("model_configs"."kind" = 'image' and "model_configs"."image_prices" is not null and "model_configs"."image_prices" <> '{}'::jsonb and "model_configs"."max_images" is not null and cardinality("model_configs"."ratios") > 0)

preset_proposals_new_check.name: preset_proposals_new_check
preset_proposals_new_check.value: "preset_proposals"."preset_id" is not null or ("preset_proposals"."label" is not null and "preset_proposals"."prompt" is not null)

settings_byteplus_pack_check.name: settings_byteplus_pack_check
settings_byteplus_pack_check.value:
("settings"."byteplus_pack_total_tokens" is null) = ("settings"."byteplus_pack_tokens" is null) and ("settings"."byteplus_pack_total_tokens" is null) = ("settings"."byteplus_pack_as_of" is null) and ("settings"."byteplus_pack_total_tokens" is null) = ("settings"."byteplus_pack_expires_at" is null)
        and ("settings"."byteplus_pack_total_tokens" is null or ("settings"."byteplus_pack_total_tokens" > 0 and "settings"."byteplus_pack_tokens" between 0 and "settings"."byteplus_pack_total_tokens"))

user_choices_niche_check.name: user_choices_niche_check
user_choices_niche_check.value: "user_choices"."niche" is null or char_length("user_choices"."niche") between 1 and 30
